# Project File Inventory

## Summary

- **Total relevant files audited:** 4511
- **Files marked complete (✅):** 3765
- **Files marked incomplete/broken/unwired (❌):** 746
- **Key risk areas:** Root Config (62 issues), Scripts (134 issues), Admin Components (11 issues), Components/business (11 issues), SITA Components (98 issues), UI Primitives (shadcn) (22 issues), Hooks (11 issues), Lib/core-services (58 issues), Lib/data-services (11 issues), Services (25 issues)
- **Major unfinished features:** Demo data only (no live backend wiring for most domain pages); many services/engines are standalone modules not consumed at runtime

## Legend

- ✅ Complete / correctly wired / appears functional
- ❌ Incomplete / broken / not wired / missing dependencies / suspicious

- Most domain pages (Business, Money, Concierge, Investment) use hardcoded demo data arrays — not wired to live database queries
- Edge functions exist but many are not called from the frontend
- Services/engines modules exist but many are standalone utility files not consumed by any component
- Electron integration files exist but desktop app packaging is not verified
- Test coverage is minimal relative to codebase size

### 4. Recommended Next Steps (Priority Order)

1. **Wire domain pages to real database** — Replace demo data arrays with Supabase queries
2. **Audit orphaned components** — Remove or wire the files not imported anywhere
3. **Connect edge functions to frontend** — Ensure each edge function has a corresponding client-side call
4. **Add integration tests** — Cover critical flows (auth, approvals, sync)
5. **Remove TODO/FIXME markers** — Resolve all outstanding code markers
6. **Verify Electron build** — Ensure desktop packaging works end-to-end
7. **Performance audit** — Lazy-load heavy admin pages, code-split by domain
